test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CHEW' is coded as '39' and 'FORE' is coded as '44'. What is the code for 'GLIT' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values according to English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• 'CHEW' is coded as '39'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de94403e96d4999f83448aa9d4bd2d823ef4a106d99a6d5cf32dea608eb9ea6f.png] 

And, 

 
• 'FORE' is coded as '44'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d78ed2ffe507772647337f108402aeb4977ccbf5c14c40883c46dae4ca9a4792.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'GLIT' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a7c1557ed65a85c98b0ef031bfbb48a1b528148fc758f5a35e6ab668b09835e.png] 

Hence, "48" is the correct answer.
